About.title: About
About.intro: Web developer based in Cameroon, focused on frontend with React, Next.js and TypeScript.
About.body1: Passionate about new technologies and the web, I specialised in building modern applications. I love designing clear interfaces, understanding user needs and shipping useful, tested, scalable products.
About.body2: Across my experiences, I've worked on payment platforms, job boards, digital libraries and internal tools. I've touched UX/UI, documented REST API integration, state management and front-to-back data sync.
About.body3: My goal: grow into a fullstack role, then into project management, while staying deeply technical.
